div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
phase_planner — NODE
LLM call, structured output, NO tools bound
decides focus_field, next_action,
retrieval_strategy, tools_needed

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
phase_executor — NODE — the coach
built with create_agent, see Diagram 3
TimeoutPolicy run_timeout=45s
error_handler=phase_error_recovery

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
four-layer validation stack
2a coherence LLM · 2b field presence DETERMINISTIC
2c constraint LLM · 2d rubric grader middleware
cheapest first, each fires only if the previous passes
iteration cap of 3 SHARED across all four layers

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
gate_review_node — NODE
calls interrupt() — EXECUTION STOPS HERE
Belt sees the validated fields, edits, approves
no checkpoint has been committed yet

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
gate_apply_node — NODE
applies the Belt's corrections
runs the policy advisory — non-blocking
CHECKPOINT COMMITS ONLY HERE

span.p:
subgraph exit — output mapper writes artifacts to the store,
returns only orchestration values to the parent
